Weeknight Chicken Tacos 🌮✨

Ingredients:
- 1 lb chicken breast, diced
- 1 tbsp olive oil
- 2 tsp taco seasoning
- 8 small tortillas
- 1 cup shredded lettuce
- 1 tomato, diced
- 1/2 cup shredded cheese
- 1/4 cup sour cream
- Fresh cilantro
- Lime wedges

Instructions:
1. Heat oil in skillet over medium-high heat
2. Season chicken with taco seasoning
3. Cook chicken until golden and cooked through (6-8 mins)
4. Warm tortillas in dry pan or microwave
5. Assemble tacos: chicken, lettuce, tomato, cheese
6. Top with sour cream and cilantro
7. Squeeze lime over tacos and serve!

Perfect for busy weeknights! 💯
